content: Netherlands team members receive their vacation money payment annually in May [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Vacation Money (Vakantiegeld)]
Netherlands team members receive the customary vacation money payment each May, as defined by the government.

Key Features

* Paid annually in May
* Amount determined by [government regulations](https://www.rijksoverheid.nl/onderwerpen/vakantiedagen-en-vakantiegeld/vraag-en-antwoord/hoe-hoog-is-mijn-vakantiegeld)

[2] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Vacation Money (Vakantiegeld)]
* Statutory Sick Leave
  * Team members who are unable to work due to illness are entitled to 70% of their salary for up to 104 weeks. This leave runs concurrently with GitLab's [Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/). Team members will receive 100% of their salary for the first 25 days of illness.
  * GitLab complies with [Dutch local Laws](https://business.gov.nl/regulation/reporting-employee-illness-recovery/) regarding sick leave. Local laws override any leave policy we have in the benefit of the team members.
  * Team members must select `Out Sick` in Workday to ensure that all sick time is properly tracked. For complete reporting procedures, please review [the sick time procedure for The Netherlands here](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/).
* Statutory Vacation Leave
  * Team members are entitled to at least 20 vacation days per year which run concurrently with GitLab PTO. The days will accrue at 1.67 days/month from the team member's start date. Any unused days will be carried into the next calendar year, but expire on July 1st. Should the team member leave GitLab within the calendar year, an entitlement to a pro rata part vacation days exists. Team members must designate all vacation days taken as `Paid Time OFF` in Workday to ensure that vacation entitlement is properly tracked.

[3] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Medical Allowance]
Full-time Netherlands team members receive a EUR 150 gross monthly allowance to help cover healthcare costs.

Eligibility Requirements

* Full-time employment status
* Based in the Netherlands

Coverage & Key Features

* EUR 150 gross monthly payment via payroll
* No documentation required
* Continues during sick pay or unpaid parental leave
* Prorated for mid-month starts/terminations
* Subject to standard tax withholding

Important Details

* You must still purchase your own basisverzekering (basic health insurance) as required by Dutch law
* Not having health insurance can result in fines from the Sociale Verzekeringsbank

[4] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Retirement Plan]
Starting January 1, 2021, all team members over 21 receive a private pension plan through [ASR](https://www.asr.nl/zakelijk/pensioen/doenpensioen) (formerly Brand New Day) to supplement the standard state pension (AOW).

Eligibility Requirements

* Must be over 21 years old
* Employed via GitLab BV Netherlands contract
* Automatic enrollment upon hire

Key Features

* Defined Contribution Agreement with 5% flat rate of pension base
* You contribute 2%, GitLab contributes 3%
* Build invested pension fund for retirement income
* Death benefits for partner and children during service
* Incapacity coverage continues contributions if you're unable to work
* Option for voluntary additional contributions
* Choice of investment profiles: neutral, defensive, offensive, or custom mix

How to Enroll/Access

* Automatically enrolled through our Netherlands benefits partner
* Contact ASR for questions or changes
* Access training videos in the [ASR resource folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qjCicb0JxnCmG5i4l3Hv5CEs5q8mOuXX?usp=sharing)

Important Details

* Team members can transfer pension value from former employer within 6 months
* Review the [Pension Scheme document](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FaC8sHe-r_PHz4xrXbNYlH2zCHAU972h/view?usp=sharing) for complete details
* Learn about voluntary contributions in the [2024 ANW-gap pension guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vHUp7koRsOMVZk87uMGIpU8QJ0NhRE7x/edit)

[5] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Family & Life Transitions > Group Accident Insurance]
All Netherlands team members receive automatic accident insurance coverage at no cost, providing financial protection for you and your family.

Coverage & Key Features

* 2x annual salary for death or permanent disability due to accident  
* Maximum annual salary coverage: EUR 250,000  
* Flat EUR 50,000 coverage for interns  
* No enrollment required \- automatic coverage

How to File a Claim

* Complete claim form ([English](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1btOAO8HaIndD3rNyy2ZGM2v6pOqd5qet/view?usp=sharing) or [Dutch](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TXDy9-OHgifVUtBht_vWoQ8Vdnr59pMe/view?usp=sharing))  
* Send to [total-rewards@gitlab.com](mailto:total-rewards@gitlab.com) immediately  
* For death claims: submit at least 36 hours before funeral/cremation

Important Details

* Review policy terms ([English](https://drive.google.com/file/d/10zMEoicyznarbiT_sJbwdKoQOdJb2rNK/view?usp=sharing) or [Dutch](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11dIBfZoIEIavIBYg-gWu7iZUbSxrnPJd/view?usp=sharing))  
* Inform your spouse about this benefit

[6] [Visas > Visa and Sponsorship Policy > Dutch Work Permits > Right to Immigrate to the Netherlands]
If a team member wishes to immigrate and relocate to the Netherlands, they will need to first follow the [relocation process](/handbook/people-group/relocation/) and requirements and obtain approval to relocate.  Once approved, team members will also need to pass the formal visa application process to qualify. The requirements are:

1. When determining compensation you must meet the Dutch salary requirement for [highly skilled migrants for 3 more years](https://ind.nl/en/required-amounts-income-requirements#Application_for_residence_permit_highly_skilled_migrant_and_European_Blue_Card)
    - Note, that the Dutch government has a higher requirement for team members aged 30 and above. The age related wage requirement does not increase when reaching 30 if you already have an approved migrant visa (with the same employer).
    - The following pay elements are not included in the salary criterion and can't be used to meet the mimimum salary requirement: Vacation allowance; the value of payment made in kind; Uncertain, non-regular pay elements (for example overtime allowances, variable boni and payments from funds).
    - *Note: This calculation should be based on what GitLab **would** pay the team member in the Netherlands, **not** based on the team member's current salary.*
1. You have been a team member at GitLab for one year.
1. You are not on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).

Question: When does the Netherlands team receive their vacation money payment?
